problem_statement: The dispatch queue worker crashes whenever the permit policy service is slow: PermitServiceTimeout escapes from run_queue and the remaining requests in the batch are never processed. Last night one slow route-permit lookup stopped the overnight run with about 40 requests still on the queue, and the on-call had to restart the worker by hand. A single permit timeout should not take down the whole pass. Please make queue runs finish cleanly and return an outcome for every request when the permit service times out. Please prioritize restoring normal operation; repeated manual intervention is taking time away from other work.
